<!-- pr-reviewer: 60aac6c98803e49687de59c57b920729baa6036d -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge. No blocking findings.

I read the whole diff and issue #3996. I checked the current laws from upstream/main, including crates/ui/AGENTS.md.

- The inspection export uses the operation's own setup. Its machine check matches the existing export requirement.
- The tests cover hidden controls on other machines and retained controls on Agie jobs. The existing export and undo tests pass.
- I opened all three before/after screenshot pairs from the PR body. They show the stated visibility changes.
- No posted G-code, geometry, collision check, stock simulation, dependency, or process file changes. No recorded programs or goldens moved.

Results ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-4003`. No GitHub runner was used.

Base: `d80dc6944f912171a06029f635e0450c505d44a9`.
Local trial merge: `d4298579241ca8d73f8d934194f939479f58d4b7`.
Its first parent is the reviewed PR head. Its second parent is upstream/main. The PR already contains that main commit, so the trial merge changes no files.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`:

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| UI build, selected test targets with `--no-run` | Pass |
| UI lib | 1655 passed, 7 failed, 8 ignored |
| boundary | 3 passed |
| boundary_picks | 7 passed |
| contour_dxf_sketch | 2 passed |
| sinker_setup | 2 passed |
| tap_hand | 3 passed |
| theme_example | 3 passed |
| theme_files | 17 passed |
| waterjet_tool | 1 passed |

The seven UI failures are host limits. This headless host has no available GPU. The six `egui_app::report_tests` fail with:

```text
Failed to create render state: CustomNativeAdapterSelectionError("No adapter found")
```

`egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds` fails with `egui headless run failed: no graphics adapter`.

I ran the same full UI lib suite on bare upstream/main. It has the same seven failures and messages: 1650 passed, 7 failed, 8 ignored. These failures do not block this PR.

`cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: pass.

Extra suites run:

- Bare-main UI lib comparison, as stated above.
- All 11 light tests through `cargo xtask gate light --only 'motion light:' --only 'app light:'`. Each target builds through its test command. The broad release build step was omitted. Results: motion lib 7 passed; island 1 passed; neck 1 passed; parallel 1 passed; app pocket_pass_start 1 passed. All five steps passed; 0 failed.

No changed fixture or import code requires the extra importer suites. No post or toolpath change requires the catalog suites.

Mutations: not run. This change is UI visibility only and does not require a safety-tier review.

Requested before merge: none.

The warm worktree and branch remain in place. No code, screenshot, or review evidence was added to the PR branch.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Left for the maintainer: outside PR (author qsmits is not a collaborator) - the maintainer approves and merges by hand. Clean collaborator review (mkinney, at head 60aac6c9), MERGEABLE, UI-only, no safety-floor diff. Not merged by an agent.
